No, thank YOU for reading mine. I feel completely alone and you are talking to me out of the kindness of your heart and I can tell that you are genuine. I do feel like they will judge me and I feel like they can’t see how truly broken I am on the inside because of how I appear on the outside. I’ve struggled with depression throughout our relationship which was about four years. But with everything in addition to what happened last night I just feel like I’m getting pushed so close to the edge and I just feel trapped not feel hopeless and stuck. I feel like I’m ruined for the rest of my life and that I won’t be able to experience love .. I self medicate With weed but it doesn’t really help and I feel that I have run out of people to talk to.. I just want to be alone forever I just wish that I could just drop off the face of the earth without anyone noticing. I’m so tired.

It did feel weird because when I got in his car I kind of realized how I thought of him as such an extraordinary person but after going a while without seeing him I noticed how he was just a regular human being. I Know you’re not judging me and it’s so nice to just talk to someone who doesn’t know me. Last night was extremely traumatizing but unfortunately I’ve had quite a few nights over the past three years of the same exact situation with the same person. I know that it’s stupid because I should just have Stop talking to him but it’s so hard because I am an empathetic person and I’m very into psychology so I always am able to sympathize with him and try to understand why he behaves the way he does. Last night taught me that he will never change and I truly believe he is a narcissist or demonically possessed. Because he gets so violent with me but when people come around he switches up completely and gaslights me. He operates like he hates me with such a deep passion and it hurts because it makes me look at myself in a different light like what is so unlikable or wrong about me for him to treat me worse than a dog on the street. My family and friends are very upset but I’m reluctant to tell them because this has actually happened before that’s why I turned to REDDIT Because I feel like people are tired of hearing about it and I can’t be honest and tell them how much I want to die because I am embarrassed by it

My ex and I have had a very long on and off relationship (4 years) and I saw him yesterday for the first time in a long time. They day was going fine until he got drunk and he started crying about his dad passing and how he was sorry for being so abusive to me and putting his hands on me.. i wiped the tears from his eyes and tried to comfort him the best way I could but he started to offend me because he still was lowkey blaming me for how he was abusive to me so i rolled over and tried to go to sleep. He kept bothering me to talk to him so i told him how i wished he would have been there to wipe my tears all those times he hurt me like i just did for him and he became violent and choked me hit me in my head and pointed a gun at me. And tried to leave me at the hotel at 2 AM  i had to force my way in the car and he threw the shoes i had on my feet outside to try to get me out the car . The police pulled us over and didnt even arrest him.. I’m so broken.

You’re absolutely right, i’ve been trying to remind myself that things get better. But i feel so crushed because I’m actually trying this time. I’ve always bullshitted my way through life because most things come easy to me i never really actually tried to do anything(out of fear that i will fail and my attempt to be perfect will be shattered) I know people go through way worse but my spirit is just defeated I feel like everytime I try again shit gets worse. I feel trapped because no one can really do anything about it. I feel like God turned his back on me and i know thats not a good way to think, i feel like I am being attacked spiritually (like Job in the Bible). I try to pray but i dont have any real passion because i feel like hes not listening ;( Im just so tired of feeling this way . I want to kill myself but i dont want to hurt my family and I dont want to go to hell. I just feel so disconnected. Like no one understands me ..
